posts.subject: Lenovo Legion 24-15 – High-Pitched Coil Whine at 240Hz (Color/Load Dependent)
posts.author: ata03
posts.message_html:
Hello Lenovo Support Team,

I recently purchased a Lenovo Legion 24-15 monitor, and I am experiencing an audible high-pitched coil whine coming from the rear of the unit (near the power and DisplayPort input area) when running at its native 240Hz refresh rate.

Here are my specific findings after troubleshooting:

Refresh Rate Dependency: At 144Hz, the monitor is relatively silent. However, switching to 240Hz produces a noticeable high-pitched whine that is audible from a normal seating distance in a quiet room.

Color/Panel Load Pattern: At 240Hz, fullscreen pure black screens produce relatively little noise, whereas fullscreen solid RGB colors (Red, Green, or Blue) and bright/colorful desktop content immediately trigger and amplify the whine.

Setup & Verification: Tested via DisplayPort 1.4 and directly connected to a separate wall outlet. Adjusting brightness and disabling HDR slightly reduces the intensity, but the issue persists at 240Hz.

Could you please confirm whether this level of coil whine at 240Hz is considered within normal operating specifications for the Legion 24-15, or if it qualifies for a hardware inspection/replacement under warranty?

Thank you for your assistance.
